characters.name: Chevalier des Grieux
characters.description: Young gentleman who falls passionately in love with Manon Lescaut; central male protagonist of the narrative recounted to the narrator

characters.name: Manon Lescaut
characters.description: Beautiful young woman whose beauty and caprice drive the events of the tale; lover/mistress of the Chevalier des Grieux

characters.name: Tiberge
characters.description: Friend and moral counsellor of des Grieux who repeatedly seeks to reclaim him to a virtuous life

characters.name: M. Lescaut
characters.description: Manon's brother; opportunistic, provides advice and connections that affect des Grieux and Manon's fortunes

characters.name: Marcel
characters.description: Servant (Manon's servant) who participates in the elopement plot and later reports events; small but recurrent role

characters.name: M. de B----
characters.description: Wealthy Fermier-général connected to Manon's first removal from des Grieux (figures in early Paris intrigues)

characters.name: M. de T----
characters.description: Gentleman who aids des Grieux in gaining access to Manon at the Magdalen and who befriends the couple in Paris; later assists plotting to rescue Manon

characters.name: G---- M---- (old)
characters.description: Older libertine and father (referred to as an old voluptuary) whose influence leads to Manon's incarceration and later punishment

characters.name: G---- M---- (young)
characters.description: Son of the older G---- M----; becomes infatuated with Manon and plays a direct role in events and confrontations

characters.name: Synnelet
characters.description: Nephew of the colonial governor of New Orleans; becomes passionately in love with Manon and engages in the fatal duel with des Grieux

characters.name: Governor (New Orleans)
characters.description: Colonial governor in New Orleans who controls dispositions of transported women and arranges social placements (befriends and later threatens des Grieux and Manon)

characters.name: Governor (St. Lazare)
characters.description: Official (governor) at St. Lazare prison who treats des Grieux during his confinement there

characters.name: Superior (St. Lazare)
characters.description: Religious superior at St. Lazare who supervises des Grieux's confinement and intervenes with authorities

characters.name: Lieutenant-General of Police
characters.description: Senior police official whose orders result in Manon's removal to the Magdalen and whose office carries influence over prisoners' fates

characters.name: Archers / civic guard (escort)
characters.description: Members of the civic guard who escort the convoy of women and act as guards/archers (also referred to as gendarmes/the guards)

characters.name: Porter (prison / St. Lazare/Chatelet)
characters.description: Porter(s) who appear in prison contexts (St. Lazare / Le Chatelet), assist or inform des Grieux and later help/relate Manon's fate

characters.name: Captain (of the ship to America)
characters.description: Ship's captain who conveys des Grieux, Manon and other convicts/emigrants to America and shows kindness aboard

characters.name: Chaplain (colony)
characters.description: Clergyman/chaplain in the New Orleans settlement who conveys the governor's views and religious administration in the colony

characters.name: Prince of R----
characters.description: Proprietor/host of the Hotel of Transylvania where card games are played and where des Grieux gains experience at the gaming-table
